notes.title: Dev Update!
notes.content:
Playcrafters, It's been a while,

A Steam update is overdue: Development is progressing!
Playcraft early access Alpha has receive a few updates this year: more info on Discord [url=https://discord.com/invite/playcraft]here[/url]

Since, I've been working on new, bigger systems, that will expand your creation power to another level! Those systems require longer development cycles though, and I invite you to come back in a few months to get a first taste.

Leading up to the full release of Playcraft MetaWorlds, next year, we are planning to change our model from Free-to-play to Premium. We are going to make it as affordable as possible for players and creators. Given our limited resources, I believe this model will allow us to develop the best experience possible while assuring a sustainable future for the development of our creative platform.

Our long term goal is to allow you, as creators, to monetise your creation. We will make sure this can be done the best way possible, but more on that later.

Thank you for following this project!
Have fun creating,
Zeroneus
